title: SettleMarker
description: The evidence that ONE unfinished desk change has stopped changing on the machine. Written by the kit's host procedure `up.sh desks settle <desk> --operation <id>` after it restarted the gateway and watched the desk's containers stay unchanged for a quiet window. Read by the backend adapter, once, for that operation only, and consumed. It lives at `/var/lib/ekka-backend/settle/<operation id>.json`, owned by the adapter's user, mode 0600. There is no marker for a whole gateway.

operation_id.description: The unfinished operation this settles: the adapter's request id for it, a lowercase hyphenated UUID. It is the id the desk's lock names (`admin:<operation id>`), the id a `running` answer carries and the id `ekka desk status` prints; never the call's `X-EKKA-Operation-Id`. The adapter accepts the marker for this operation and no other.

backend_id.description: The backend's id for the desk the procedure watched, a lowercase UUID. Null ONLY for a create whose desk the kit could not find by its labels: the create never reached the desk, and then `containers` must be []. The adapter accepts null only when its own GetSandbox read-back after the restart finds no desk; it refuses a marker whose id is not the desk the operation targeted.

gateway_identity.description: `<backend_gateway.url>#<backend_gateway.workspace>` from the adapter's config, built the same way by the kit's settle procedure. Compared byte for byte; a marker from another gateway is refused.

gateway_restarted_at.description: When the procedure restarted the gateway, UTC.

quiet_until.description: The end of the quiet window: from the restart until this time the desk's containers and their states did not change. Later than `gateway_restarted_at`.

containers.description: The desk's containers and their states at `quiet_until`, found by OpenShell's labels. Empty when the change removed them.

state.description: Docker's state. `restarting` and `removing` are never settled: the procedure writes no marker while one is.
